operator: Peoples Bus Service (Red Bus) — Sindh Mass Transit Authority
notes: Sources: SMTA official per-route pages smta.gos.pk/routes/{1..14} (full ordered 'via' stop lists, origin/dest, distance, fleet, active/inactive status) + smta.gos.pk/route-map + Wikipedia. Scope = Peoples Bus Service (Red Bus) ACTIVE routes only: R4, R8, R11, R12, R13, R14. Pink Bus (R1/R2/R3 — women-only) and inactive R5/R6/R7 are excluded as they are a different service / not operational. Stop ORDER and NAMES are directly evidenced by the official route pages (high fidelity). Coordinates are geocoded from well-known Karachi landmark positions (medium fidelity, ~100-300m); shared landmark stops (Tower, ICI, Sorab Goth, Numaish, Guru Mandar, Ayesha Manzil, etc.) are de-duplicated across routes into single stop nodes. SCHEDULE: sources give only operating window (07:00-22:00 daily) and headway (~15 min peak, ~30 min off-peak), NOT timetabled clock times — so stop_times are SYNTHETIC: one representative trip per direction starting 07:00 at ~3 min/stop spacing (even-headway assumption). Real per-stop clock times are unknown, hence confidence 0.55. Service runs all 7 days including public holidays (calendar service_id 'daily'). Fare PKR 50-100 (not encoded). route_type=3 (bus) for all.
